risks: Root integration may change inspected files during or after preflight; hashes are mandatory generation boundaries, not durable acceptance receipts.
Historical e953786 cloudPacket base and unresolved delivery fields must not override dispatch input or the required wave0 commit.
Hosted GitDiagram internal routes are not a stable SDK and its full Redis/R2 application must not be embedded as a second ROX service/store.

Source path/URL membership and import/name mentions can be mistaken for arbitrary semantic relation proof; unsupported interpretation must remain labeled.

Current authority cannot be inferred from cached receipt bindings or provider.allowedProviderIds; live actor/source policy and offline revocation behavior remain external readiness gates.
A compiler/security unit result would not prove actual renderer behavior, commit navigation, authorization, job restart recovery or stale-artifact outage behavior.
New files alone are not integration: public exports, dependency-owned jobs, shared explainer projection, staged artifact ownership and actual graph surface need lead-owned wiring and proof.
Upstream schema/security summaries and syntactically valid manifest hashes are not installed-provider, source hash-readback, MIT notice or deployed private-flow audit receipts.
